Garchomp Dragon Claw into Dragonite under Tailwind outspeeds all foes, doing 57-131%—strong KO chance from 66%. If Dragonite survives, it likely KOs Garchomp with Ice Punch, but Annihilape remains healthy at +2/+2 for the 1v2 endgame. This line simultaneously covers Sneasler disruption and maximizes Garchomp's last-turn value.

Drain Punch chosen over Rage Fist because it hits Staraptor (neutral) on switch, avoiding Ghost immunity. Garchomp outspeeds Dragonite (169 vs 145 max) so Dragon Claw lands before Tailwind or Ice Punch. Opponent must also send a replacement for fainted Kingambit; Staraptor Intimidate triggers Defiant boosting Annihilape further.

Opponent must send replacement for fainted Kingambit this turn (Sneasler or Staraptor). Staraptor Intimidate will trigger Annihilape Defiant for net +1 Atk.

decisions.rationale: Dragonite 12% vs +2 Atk Annihilape; any attack KOs (Drain 20-40% base, +2 ~40-80%). Ice Punch 17-48% base reduced by +2 Def. Extreme Speed immune. Only Protect avoids immediate loss and forces opponent to reveal second active.

Only winning path is opponent sending Sneasler by mistake (Sneasler walled by Ghost typing). Rage Fist secures Dragonite KO to force the 1v1 and win that scenario. No line beats optimal Staraptor send.

Staraptor Brave Bird OHKOs Annihilape through +2 Def. Opponent Staraptor is Jolly SharpBeak Intimidate; Sneasler is Jolly FocusSash Unburden.

decisions.rationale: Dragonite 12% dies to any boosted hit. Protect is 50% after last turn success and only delays same KO. Ice Punch guarantees chip 18-43% raw (less after +2 Def) vs Annihilape before faint, best damage vs 1v3 endgame.

Staraptor outspeeds (115-167 vs 110) and Brave Bird into +2Def does 92.5-181%, OHKOing ~91.5% of the time. No line beats that cleanly. Drain Punch foe slot (Staraptor) is my only path: survive low roll, KO Staraptor with +3Atk Drain Punch (76-238% range), heal ~40% HP, tank Ice Punch (18-34.5% at +2Def), then KO Dragonite next turn. Protecting lets Tailwind through and only delays. Sneasler is completely walled and will not be sent.

reflections.summary: Lost because preview plan brought Kingambit + Dragonite + Perish trap Gengar-Mega/Sinistcha into Bulk Up Annihilape. Kingambit is weak to Drain Punch and got burned (88% brn T5), then OHKOed. Dragonite's priority Extreme Speed is Normal-immune vs Ghost Annihilape, leaving only weak Ice Punch (85% to 90% after Leftovers). Annihilape got 2 free Bulk Ups to +2/+2 under Talonflame Tailwind + Protect and solo-swept endgame.
reflections.adjustment: Do not bring Kingambit and Gengar-Mega Perish core vs this Annihilape/Talonflame. Bring Fairy/Psychic special attacker or Taunt/Haze/Encore to stop Bulk Up, and ensure damage into Annihilape is not Normal priority or physical contact (avoids Rough Skin + Drain sustain). Need burn immunity/Lum or special breaker.
reflections.notebook: Opp wincon confirmed: Talonflame Tailwind -> Annihilape Bulk Up x2 + Protect stall + Drain Punch sustain + Rage Fist finisher to +2/+2. Uses Will-O-Wisp to cripple physical (Kingambit burned). Garchomp Sash broken early, used as late sac at 1%. Perish trap with Shadow Tag fails vs Protect + Bulk Up. Future plan: avoid Kingambit, avoid Normal priority vs Ghost, bring Taunt or Haze or strong Fairy special damage for Annihilape, and check Wisp source.

reflections.summary: The opponent did not bring Staraptor or Sneasler, leaving them without a Flying-type move to threaten Annihilape. Annihilape freely set up two Bulk Ups and swept with Drain Punch, as Dragonite’s neutral Ice Punch did negligible damage after boosts and Kingambit was burned and removed early.
reflections.adjustment: In future games against this opponent, expect them to bring Staraptor (Jolly SharpBeak Intimidate) as a direct Annihilape answer. Be prepared to bring a Rock-type or faster priority attacker to handle Staraptor, or use Annihilape’s Protect to scout and pivot into a Flying resist when Staraptor is on the field.
reflections.notebook: Sneasler entirely walled by Annihilape Ghost typing (Fake Out/Close Combat immune, Poison Jab/Rock Slide 0.5x). Staraptor Brave Bird OHKOs Annihilape through +2 Def. Opponent Staraptor is Jolly SharpBeak Intimidate; Sneasler is Jolly Focus Sash Unburden. In Game 3, opponent brought Mega Gengar, Sinistcha, Dragonite, Kingambit, leaving Staraptor and Sneasler benched. Dragonite held Yache Berry. Kingambit was burned and defeated early by Annihilape. The lack of Flying-type pressure allowed Annihilape to set up and sweep uncontested. Future games: anticipate Staraptor as the primary Annihilape counter; consider a hard Staraptor check in team selection, and use Protect to avoid Brave Bird.
